list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase and cross-checked against PowerPyx, GamesRadar+, GameMapa, GTADB and games.gg (2026-11-20)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54. There is no online requirement and no DLC. The last one in for most players is the 100% gold, A Long Road, so treat its checklist as the spine of the whole run.
steps: Finish the story to collect the 12 story trophies
Work the 100% Completion checklist for A Long Road
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the open-world trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1 — just keep playing.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when Chapter 1 is done.
steps: Complete every Chapter 1 story mission

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when Chapter 2 is done.
steps: Complete every Chapter 2 story mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when Chapter 3 is done.
steps: Complete every Chapter 3 story mission

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when Chapter 4 is done.
steps: Complete every Chapter 4 story mission

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Free roam stays open afterwards, so nothing is gated behind it.
steps: Complete the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
steps: Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Child's Play in Chapter 4.
steps: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Headliners in Chapter 4.
steps: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
steps: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long pole of the platinum: the 100% Completion checklist, under Progress > Stats, visible only after the story. It is nearer 60% of the game's actual content — most side quests are not on it. You must clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the 80 challenges.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist unlocks after it
Clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest
Scan vehicles (200 of 277) and study animals (100 of 255) as you go
Do 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the hardest 10

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Finish any 250 of the 397 stunts — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. The Progress menu keeps a running total, so knock them off while travelling; you do not need all 397.
steps: Use fast cars and bikes; stunt jumps are marked on the map
Knife Flights and under-bridge flights count too
Check Progress to see your running total

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. A single attempt at each is enough — no wins required.
steps: Fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt
One attempt at each type is enough

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Gold is the top medal; practise the weapon types you are weakest on. Ranges are repeatable and free.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges
Gold each of the 42 challenges — replays are free

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough, and losing costs nothing — retry until the line is clean.
steps: Race at all 14 Top Fun locations
One win per location is enough

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Any vehicle class counts; pick the 20 shortest circuits and learn their corners instead of grinding one track.
steps: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal's questline starts in Chapter 1 — follow it until he challenges you, then out-fish him.
steps: Follow Cal's questline from Chapter 1
Beat him in the fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade video games; three of them are on the TV at home, so you can do this between missions without travelling.
steps: Play any of the 4 arcade games to completion
Three are on the TV at home

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Andy's quests, then his final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and opens from Chapter 3 — play it whenever you are Lucia.
steps: Play as Lucia, from Chapter 3
Finish Andy's 5 quests, then the finale

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all 7 shipwrecks for Kenton, then his final mission. Kenton's strand opens in Chapter 1. Shipwrecks are dive sites — work through them one by one.
steps: Open Kenton's strand in Chapter 1
Clear all 7 shipwrecks, then the finale

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Billy's quests at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, then his final mission. Billy's strand opens from Chapter 2.
steps: Visit the Thrillbilly Mud Club from Chapter 2
Finish Billy's 5 quests, then the finale

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Stranger icons appear on the map as the story advances, and each strand ends with its own finale. This is the post-story cleanup step — no strand is required for 100%.
steps: Follow stranger icons as they appear
Finish 8 full strands, finale included

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, then his final mission. Randy's strand opens from Chapter 3. Stolen cars in good condition count — deliver them as you find them rather than hunting all 16 at once.
steps: Open Randy's strand from Chapter 3
Deliver all 16 wish-list cars, then the finale

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs, then finish Tyrone's final quest. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens from Chapter 3.
steps: Play as Jason, from Chapter 3
Destroy the labs, then the finale

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across Leonida. The one trophy you can miss: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and he can meditate on the balcony — that session is only available in Chapter 1. The rest of the spots are marked and can be done any time; the last one needs both characters (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2).
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate
Find the other 17 marked Meditation Spots across Leonida
The final spot needs both characters (after Coffee Break, Ch. 2)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only. Note: as of 2026-11-20 the exact animal is still being confirmed by the guides — check the cited pages for the latest word before you hunt.
steps: Play as Jason and open Bret's strand
Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (there are 18 sets in total). Cards are found across Leonida; you only need 3 full sets, so focus on the sets you are closest to finishing.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida
Complete any 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Scanning is also how you discover vehicles, so do it whenever you pass somewhere new.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures
Scan 100 locations in total

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The challenges come in 8 groups of 10. The trophy needs 50, while the 100% checklist needs 70 — so you can skip the hardest ones for this trophy and come back for the rest later.
steps: Work through the 8 challenge groups (10 each)
50 done earns the trophy; 70 are needed for 100%

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Robbing a bank vault gives you a 4-star level instantly, so this often pops on its own. The easiest escape reported is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
steps: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner (a bank vault does it)
Escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia
It pops once you leave the red heat zone

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well. The trophy is delayed — it pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third store.
steps: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner
Stay wanted the whole time
Wait ~30 seconds after the third store — the pop is delayed

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan of a new vehicle is enough to count it — scan everything you drive or pass.
steps: WAiNK-scan every new vehicle you see
100 discovered earns the trophy

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work at every location — try a gang illegal operation.
steps: Buff focus: food, drinks or a shower; carry Adrenaline
Trigger Combat Focus at a gang illegal operation
Down 5 gang members before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal an airliner docked at a boarding bridge (terminals E3/E4 are reported as the easiest) and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.
steps: Go to VCIA, terminals E3/E4
Steal a docked airliner and fly 1 km away

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station. Expect heavy resistance — plan the getaway, not just the theft.
steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station
Steal a Rhino tank and get clear

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which arrives in Chapter 3 — do not attempt this before then.
steps: Wait until Chapter 3, when you have the Snap Gun
Rob a jewelry store unseen

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are part of the robbery loop the 100% checklist also requires, so each successful escape counts twice over.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape, 5 times
Vaults also count toward 100%

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — intercept one, crack it and lose the heat.
steps: Intercept an armored truck on its route
Rob it and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. Drive, fly and sail the edges; the Progress menu shows which regions are still fogged.
steps: Visit every region until the map fog is gone
Check Progress for regions still unexplored

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist). One per gang is enough — pick the easiest operation for each gang.
steps: Rob one illegal operation per gang
9 gangs in total

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No verified method yet: PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown as of 2026-11-20. The description points at Ocean Beach bars with a view — try ordering a cocktail there and check the cited guides for the confirmed method.
steps: Try Ocean Beach bars with a view
Order a cocktail and see if it pops

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No verified method yet: PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown. The description suggests driving a car out through a showroom's front — check the cited guides for the confirmed method.
steps: Try driving out through a vehicle showroom's front

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. This is a robbery with a specific loot list — grab the three valuables, then break line of sight.
steps: Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn
Take all 3 key valuables, then lose the police

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.
steps: Train at the gym together
Both characters' Strength must max out at once

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Anything that moves your profile counts — robberies, thefts, getaways. It accumulates across the whole game, so it usually pops during the 100% cleanup.
steps: Keep playing: robberies, thefts and getaways all count
500 profile actions earns it

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No verified method yet: PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — check the cited guides for the confirmed method.
steps: No confirmed trigger yet — see the cited guides

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No verified method yet: PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown. The description hints at witnessing something strange in the world — check the cited guides for the confirmed method.
steps: No confirmed trigger yet — see the cited guides

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No verified method yet: PowerPyx lists the exact trigger as unknown, but the description points at hitting someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — the bowling alley area is the natural place to try.
steps: Try a melee attack from a moving vehicle
The bowling alley area is the natural place to try

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them steadily instead of sitting on them.
steps: Rob to collect Marked Bills
Launder $250,000 through fences

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Normal play gets you most of the way there; top up with vehicles, clothes and ammo late in the game.
steps: Spend across any shops — it all counts
Vehicles, clothes and ammo top it up

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties ($160,000 in total). Garages also store the cars Randy wants, so buy them as the money comes in.
steps: Buy all 8 garages — $160,000 in total

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 vehicles you own count — register them as you collect them.
steps: Register 10 owned vehicles in the Scooter Bros app
